test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Numerical Ability (Held on: 20 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A shopkeeper purchased 12 dozen eggs at the rate of ₹60 per dozen. He sold the eggs at ₹6 per piece. What was his profit percentage?
solution:
**Given:**

Cost price (CP) of 12 dozen eggs = ₹60 per dozen

Selling price (SP) of 1 egg = ₹6 per piece

**Formula used:**

Profit percentage = dfrac{Profit}{CP} times 100

Profit = SP - CP
